LESSON: SARUFI 10.4.1 VINYUME NOMINO VIVUMISHI

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno
2. kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
3. kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 10.4.1 Vinyume nomino vivumishi important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza dhana ya kinyume cha maneno
2. kutambua vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini
3. kutumia vinyume vya nomino na vivumishi katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
